chapter.verse: Tua ciangin Pilate in Jesu samsakin satna thuaksak hi.
Galkapte in kumpi-lukhu danin linggui khat vialin Jesu' lu tungah koih uh a, puantual sandum khat silhsak uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu nehphei-in, “Jew Kumpipa, khansau ta in!” ci uh a, a khut uh tawh zong paangbet phapha uh hi.
Pilate pusuak leuleu-in Jew mite' kiangah, “En un, ama' tungah khialhna ka muh loh lam na theih nadingun note' kiangah amah kong paikhiatpih hi,” ci hi.
Tua ciangin ling lukhu khu-in puantual sandum a silh Jesu hong pusuak hi. Pilate in Jew mite' kiangah, “En un, hih takah mihingpa!” ci hi.

Siampi liante leh zum nasemte in Jesu a muh uh ciangin, “Amah khailum in, amah khailum in!” ci-in awng uh hi. Pilate in, “Ama' tungah mawhsak nading thu mu lo ka hih manin nomaumah in man unla khailum un,” ci hi.
Jew mite in, “Thukhun khat ka nei uh a, tua tungtawnin hileh amah a sih ding kilawm hi. A hang pen amahmah Pasian' Tapa kici hi,” ci uh hi.
Hih thu a zak ciangin Pilate lau semsem hi.
Mang innpi sungah lut leuleu-in Jesu' kiangah, “Koi pana hong pai na hi hiam?” ci hi. Ahih hangin Jesu in dawnkikna nei lo hi.
Tua ciangin Pilate in, “Kei tawh kiho sawm lo na hi hiam? Nang hong kikhahkhiat nading thu leh hong kikhailup nading thu ka neih lam thei lo na hi hiam?” ci hi.
Jesu in, “Tunglam pan hong kiguat kei nakleh kei' tungah uktheihna thu na nei kei ding hi. Tua hi a, nang' kianga kei hong apte a mawhna uh lianzaw lai hi,” ci hi.

Tua-a kipan Pilate in Jesu a khah theih nading thu zongzong hi. Ahih hangin Jew mite kiko uh a, “Hih mipa na khahleh Caesar' lawm na hikei hi. Amahmah kumpi a kicitawm peuhmah Caesar a langpang ahi hi,” ci uh hi.
Hih thute a zak ciangin Pilate in Jesu paikhiatpih a, Hebrew-kamin Gabbatha minnei Suangphah a kicihna muna om thukhenna tokhom ah tusuk hi.
Tua ni pen Paisan Pawi Kiginni, sunkim nai sawmlenih pawl ahi hi. Jew mite' kiangah Pilate in, “Na kumpipa uh en un!” ci hi.

Amaute in, “That in! That in! Khailum in! Khailum in!” ci-in awng uh hi. Pilate in, “Na kumpipa uh ke'n khailum ding ka hi hiam?” a cih ciangin siampi liante in, “Caesar losiah kumpi dang ka nei kei uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Pilate in Jesu khailup dingin amaute' tungah ap hi. Tua ciangin amaute in Jesu man uh hi.
Jesu zong ama' singlamteh pua-in paikhia a, Hebrew-kamin Golgotha a kici, Misi Luguh Mun a cihna mun zuan hi.
Amaute in tua mun ah Jesu leh midang nih, Jesu laitasakin ama' langkhat ah khat tuak, khaikhawm uh hi.
Pilate in theihsakna laisuan khat zong gelhsakin singlamteh tungah suangsak a, tua takah: “Jew Mite' Kumpipa, Nazareth Khuami Jesu” kici hi.
Jesu a kikhailupna mun pen khuapi gei ahih banah laisuan pen Hebrew-kam, Latin-kam leh Greek-kam -te tawh kigelh ahih manin Jew mi tampitak in tua laisuan sim uh hi.
Tua hangin Jew siampi liante in Pilate' kiangah, “Laisuan ah, ‘Jew Mite' Kumpipa,’ ci kei inla, ‘Hih mipa in Jew Mite' Kumpipa ka hi, ci hi,’ cizaw in,” ci uh hi.
Pilate in, “Ka gelhsa pen ka gelhsa hi pah hi,” ci hi.
Galkapte in Jesu a khai khit uh ciangin ama' puansilhte la uh a, khen li suahin khen khatta-in hawm uh hi. A puantual sungsilh ahihleh a kikhui hilo, a tunglam pan a pumin a kigan ahih manin

amaute khatlekhat kiho uh a, “Hih balkek kei ni. Kua'n ngah ding cih i theih nadingin ai san ni,” kici uh hi. Tua pen Pasian' Laibu sunga kigen, a nuai-a thu a tangtun nading ahi hi: “Amaute in ka puantualte hawm uh a, ka puansilhte ngah nadingin ai san uh hi.” Tua hi a, galkapte tu-a bangin gamta uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu' singlamteh gei-ah a nu, a nu' sanggamnu ahi Mary (Clopas' zi) leh Magdala khuami Mary, tu-a teng ding uh hi.
Jesu in a nu leh a nu' gei-a ding ama' itdeuh nungzuipa a muh ciangin a nu' kiangah, “Numei aw, en in, na tapa om hi!” ci hi.
Tua ciangin nungzuipa' kiangah, “En in, na nu om hi!” ci hi. Nungzuipa in zong tua hunlenai panin a inn ah Jesu' nu kem hi.
Tua nung ciangin Jesu in na khempeuh kizosiang ta cih thei ahih manin (Pasian' Laibu a tangtun nadingin), “Ka dangtak,” ci hi.
Tua takah lengtui thuk a dima kikoih leibeel khat om ahih manin amaute in tua sungah tuihup diah uh a, puknah hiang khat ah khihin Jesu' muk ah tahto uh hi.
Jesu in lengtui thuk a san khit ciangin, “Kizosiang ta!” ci hi. Tua ciangin a lu puksukin a hu tawpna sangkhia hi.

Tua ni pen Kiginni ahih manin ni thupi deuh ahi Sabbath ni-in singlamteh tungah misi luang a om nawnloh ding deihna tawh Jew mite in singlamteh tunga kikhaite a khe uh kuaihtan ding leh a luangte lakkhiat dingin Pilate mangpa' kiangah phalna ngen uh hi.
Tua ciangin galkapte hong pai uh a, Jesu tawh kikhaikhawmte a masapa leh a dang khatpa a khete uh kuaihtansak uh hi.
Ahih hangin Jesu' kiangah a tun uh ciangin amah si khinta cih mu uh ahih manin a khete kuaitan lo uh hi.
Himah taleh galkapte khat in teipi tawh Jesu' pang dawt a, thakhat thu-in si leh tui luangkhia hi.
Hih thu na up theih nadingun thupiang a mupa in teci pang khinzo hi—ama' teci panna a maan hi a, thumaan thutak gen ahihlam zong amahmah in thei hi.
A hang pen, “A guhte khat nangawn kikuaitan lo ding hi,” a ci Pasian' Laibu a tangtun nadingin hih thute a piang ahi hi.
“Amaute in a dawtpa uh en ding uh hi,” ci-in zong Pasian' Laibu in a mun dang khat ah gen lai hi.

Hih thu teng khit ciangin Jesu' nungzui khat (Jew mite a kihtakna hangin a kilangsak lo) Arimathea khuami Joseph in Pilate' kiang pai-in Jesu' luang a puakkhiat theih nading ngen hi. Pilate in phalna pia ahih manin amah in Jesu' luang puakhia hi.
Jesu' kiangah zan hunin a hawh ngei Nicodemus zong singnai paknamtui leh aloes paknamtui kihelkhawm, tawi sawmnih kiim a gik, nilhthau nam khat kengin hong pai hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu' luang lakhia uh a, Jew sivui ngeina a om bangin zanamtui zutin puannel dial sung khat ah zanamtuite tawh tunkhawm uh hi.
Jesu' a kikhailupna mun ah huan khat om a, tua huan sungah kuamah a kisial nailo hankhuk a thak khat om hi.
Tua hi a, Jew mite' Kiginni lah hi-in tua hankhuk lah nai ahih manin amaute in tua takah Jesu sial uh hi.
